protocolMetadata.instructions: Saved drafts are available on every Mallary plan and are separate from publishing. Use draft tools to save, read, edit and delete unpublished content. Never submit a draft without an explicit request to publish or schedule it. Use Mallary only for explicit Mallary requests. Prefer read-only tools first. Before publishing, editing a scheduled post, replying, deleting, disconnecting, changing settings, or creating webhooks, show the exact action and wait for user confirmation. Read the current post and revision before editing. To change destinations, specify one target profile and the complete final platform list. Do not silently retry consequential writes or revision conflicts. Never request or reveal API keys, OAuth tokens, webhook secrets, or unrelated account data.

tool.name: mallary_create_upload_url
tool.title: Create media upload URL
tool.description: Create a temporary presigned URL for uploading image or video bytes to Mallary. This tool creates the URL only and does not upload a file. Upload the raw file bytes with a PUT request to uploadUrl and include every header in the returned headers object. For MP4 files, use Content-Type: video/mp4. After the upload succeeds, use mediaUrl to create the post.

type.description: The file's media type, such as video/mp4. Recommended. If omitted, Mallary uses a supported filename extension. Send type when the extension is missing or unknown.

tool.name: mallary_create_post
tool.title: Create or schedule social post
tool.description: Submit content for immediate publishing or scheduling on the user's connected social accounts. Upload media with mallary_create_upload_url, finish the upload, and use the returned files.mallary.ai media URL. External media URLs are rejected. By default this runs preflight first and fails fast if checks block publishing. If preflight blocks the post, resolve its blocking_checks and keep preflight enabled. If trial_posting_throttled is returned, respect details.retry_after and do not automatically retry. Returns Mallary job IDs immediately; platform_post_id and platform_post_url are available after publishing through job lookup and post listing.

tool.name: mallary_list_comments
tool.title: List post comments
tool.description: List comments and replies on Mallary-published posts only. Use each comment's concrete post_id and id to reply. Instagram returns parent_comment_id, is_reply, has_own_reply, replies_complete, hidden, and visibility. has_own_reply=null means unknown, not unanswered. A hidden or unverified own reply must not trigger another reply; check it in Instagram. For grouped posts, limit is per platform: use each platform_pagination entry's post_id, platform, and pagination.next_cursor. Otherwise use pagination.next_cursor. Keep profile_id and limit the same. Follow new cursors only while has_more=true; stop at has_more=false. Never reuse a cursor. If unavailable_reason is present or has_more=true with no next_cursor, stop and report the scan is incomplete. Combine all pages to match parent_comment_id with replies whose is_own=true and hidden=false. Pagination covers the comments edge, not a guarantee that every reply was returned. complete=false can remain on the last paged response. Other platforms may have unknown paging and reply status.

cursor.description: New opaque pagination.next_cursor from mallary_list_comments, or a platform_pagination entry for grouped posts. Use that entry's concrete post_id and platform with the same profile_id and limit. Never reuse a cursor. Stop at has_more=false, unavailable_reason, or has_more=true with no next_cursor. Combine all pages; complete=false can remain on the final page.
